entity.description:
The Catwoman is a minor character of the television series Mortal Kombat: Conquest, performed by stunt actress Vicki Phillips. This character does not have a name, and was only referred to as "the cat woman" by other characters.

The Catwoman is the guardian that protects the entrance of hidden city of Shakaana. She attacks Kung Lao, Siro, Taja, and Dion as they approach the entrance to the city, with Dion running for cover when she appears. Though she was able to fight all three fighters, she was still overwhelmed and made a hasty retreat. She does not appear for the remainder of the series.
